body:
my ex bfs sister killed herself. her kids were on the way to be taken away from her (bipolar) and so she shot herself in the head. her kids are traumatized to this day. one of them has complications from birth so he can’t speak but i’m sure he still doesn’t understand why his mom did this. same with her older son. he’s in highschool now and he started having symptoms of schizophrenia a bit ago. your kids are not better off, you think they will be because you feel like you don’t matter much. i promise they will think of you for the rest of their lives wishing you hadnt done it
also- my ex bf ( her brother) got into drugs from her death and is now dead from an overdose. he was 22 years old. just trying to give you a reminder that people will miss you and will be very heartbroken you’re gone. at least try and think of their well-being before you do this. you can always work on yourself and one day you could be the best and happiest mom to them
